label: Reach
cue: Keep your chest against the pad.

label: Open
cue: Open both arms with elbows softly bent.

label: Squeeze
cue: Spread the handles; keep your shoulders down.

label: Hold
cue: Hold wide without arching or shrugging.

label: Return
cue: Return slowly; keep your elbows softly bent.

label: Reset
cue: Keep tension as the handles return.
